template.name: Hosted Harness Deployment
template.summary: Packages another Harness and publishes it to a managed Conexus Cloud runtime with approval, verification, and rollback metadata.
template.description: Turns a completed Harness into a versioned hosted release. The workflow validates the source Harness, produces a deployment contract and package, requires explicit approval, publishes through the Conexus control plane, verifies the public route and API health, and records rollback information. Supabase, Vercel, and Railway remain implementation details of the managed platform; provider administrator credentials never enter the Harness.
whenToUse: The user wants to publish, host, deploy, or put a completed Harness online.
A Harness should become a user-facing hosted service with a stable URL and API.
A release needs an auditable plan, explicit approval, verification, and rollback metadata.
whenNotToUse: The source Harness is still incomplete or has no declared inputs and outputs.
The user only wants to save a Harness locally for reuse.
The user explicitly requires deployment into their own cloud account; use a future BYOC provider adapter instead of exposing provider credentials to this workflow.
